column2: (6) Where another person is appointed to fill a vacancy

column1: caused  by  the  death,  resignation,  removal  from  office  or

column2: (7) Where any appointed member is by reason of illness,

column1: infirmity or absence from Sri Lanka temporarily unable to

another person may having regard to the provisions of section
6, be appointed to act in his place.

column2: (8) Any appointed member of the Board, who is absent

column1: without leave from three consecutive meetings of the Board
shall be deemed to have vacated his office.

column2: (1) The Chairman or in absence of the Chairman,

column1: the Vice-Chairman shall preside at all meetings of the Board.
In the absence of the Chairman or Vice-Chairman from any
meeting of the Board, the members present at such meeting
shall nominate one member from amongst those present, to
preside at such meeting.

column2: (2) In the event of an equality of votes at any meeting of

column1: the  Board,  the  Chairman,  Vice-Chairman  or  the  member

column2: (3) The meetings of the Board shall be convened by the

column1: Chairman and shall be held as frequently as is necessary for

Institute under this Act.

column2: (4)  The  quorum  for  meeting  of  the  Board  shall  be  five

column1: members.

column2: (5) The Board may pay any member with the approval of

column1: the  Minister,  such  remuneration  or  allowance,  as  may  be
